description: Evidence-bounded company horizon planning, objective and KPI review, forecast-versus-actual comparison, delivery signal detection, and owner-review reprioritization.

routing.when_to_use: Use for evidence-backed monthly, rolling four-week, quarterly, annual, three-year, or five-year planning and performance review.
when_not_to_use: Do not use as a Program, project, KPI, task, or scheduling system.
Do not activate or approve reprioritization or infer unsupported forecasts.
Do not use with live credentials, customer records, or confidential company text.
exclusion_rules: Consumer owners retain plan, Program, Task, and KPI mutation authority.
Consumer adapters retain transport, credentials, and external-system authority.

required_inputs.name: planning_request
required_inputs.description: A horizon, period, evidence-linked objectives, optional KPIs/signals, privacy classification, and optional proposed reprioritization.

expected_outputs.name: planning_review
expected_outputs.description: A deterministic READY_FOR_OWNER, DRAFT, or BLOCKED review with explicit uncertainty, empty effects, and rollback.

execution.procedure_summary: Validate horizon and evidence, preserve objectives and signals, compare only comparable KPI values, and draft owner-review reprioritization without mutation.
forbidden_actions: Create or update Program, project, objective, KPI, milestone, calendar, or Task state
Approve, activate, schedule, send, or enforce planning decisions
Invent numeric precision, forecast, actual, target, or completion facts
Store credentials, customer data, or confidential company material
verification_steps: Run secret scan and generated-output closure
Confirm no prohibited catalog or mutable state paths
completion_criteria: All six horizons are represented in the canonical eval suite
Forecast-versus-actual comparison is evidence- and unit-bounded
Late, blocked, obsolete, and reprioritization records remain owner-review-only
Effects are empty and private input is rejected without echo

telemetry.retention_policy: retain synthetic IDs, evidence hashes, and receipts only
